provenance.caveat: Data: NASA GPM IMERG, rainfall estimated from satellites, about 10 km squares; the satellites changed in 2014 (TRMM to GPM) (the map averages them into 2° squares). The trend is a straight line through 1998–2025; it shows what changed, not why. The record is 28 years long, shorter than the 30 years usually used to describe a climate.
